name: RANT pair-reserve burn and sync
summary: A transfer of RANT to the token contract invoked _sellBurnLiquidityPairTokens(amount), which removed an attacker-sized amount of RANT directly from the RANT/WBNB pair and called sync() without removing WBNB. The resulting reserve collapse let rant_center sell the attacker's remaining RANT into the manipulated pair and extract its WBNB reserve.

loss.notes: The exploit transaction's WBNB transfer logs show 2,813.769505544453342436 WBNB entering the RANT/WBNB pair and 3,125.628310019077706276 WBNB leaving it across the manipulated swaps. The pair's exact transaction-local depletion was therefore 311.858804474624363840 WBNB. This gross loss exceeds the attacker's final BNB because the attacker separately paid the flash fee and a validator transfer. DefiLlama observed BNB at $655.15 at timestamp 1751728497, 99 seconds before the exploit.

ageReset.description: changeRant_node() set the node dependency used by _sellBurnLiquidityPairTokens. rant_center had been configured one block earlier, so this latest change completed the operational self-transfer, pair-burn, sync, and sell path.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit transaction, receipt and full call trace; the direct token deployment; all target setter transactions through the exploit; runtime history; extracted verified source; and historical BNB price. The exploit transaction created contracts 0x1e2d48e640243b04a9fa76eb49080e9ab110b4ac and 0xfd9267ee6594bd8e82e8030c353870fa1773f7f8. The latter flash-borrowed 2,813.769505544453342436 WBNB and used it to buy 96,605,739.642631517916080650 RANT, leaving 10,733,970.071403501990675974 RANT in the pair. It then transferred 10,733,970.071403501990675973 RANT to the token contract. RANT's self-transfer branch removed 90% of that amount from the pair to 0xdead and 10% to rant_node, then synced the pair with essentially one RANT remaining while its WBNB was unchanged. rant_center sold the attacker's remaining RANT into that reserve state. All WBNB transfers involving the pair net to an exact 311.858804474624363840 WBNB depletion; the attacker's final proceeds are lower after flash-loan and validator payments. RANT was created top-level by 0x2373241ec958124cbd3636fc9561f7ec623adbe3 at block 52727279:11. rant_center was configured at block 52727325 and transaction 0x8e8e89a2fc4eb9ca170051265a497546a25d02762e5589c975afcf3704573f00 set rant_node in slot 0x8 at block 52727326:18, completing the path because _sellBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls rant_node.depositBonusToken before rant_center.sell_rant. No later administrative setter transaction occurred before ownership was renounced. The 9,335-byte direct runtime hashes to 0xd18c3b8a0a284a08553e5d503432f78413bf032c20636561eb84add70d360261 at deployment and immediately before exploitation. DefiLlama's preceding BNB observation was $655.15 at timestamp 1751728497.
